fields.description: Issue features a major photo-based exposé alleging abusive and inhumane treatment of mental patients at the Miami Retreat (7831 N. Miami Court), including restraint and neglect of charity patients, and calls for public action and investigation. Additional editorials and reports address inflation and rent control, Dade legislative politics (including salary raises and tax consolidation), race relations and the treatment of a Black woman patient, proposals to make birth and death certificates confidential, condemnation of Biscayne Bay bottom lands, Miami International Airport animal shipments and international passenger traffic, local court cases involving gambling and alcoholism, and a labor-related exhibit by the Miami Typographical Union during a strike/lockout at local newspapers.
